headline: Xbox Elite 3 prototype pad leaks with tiny built-in screen
summary: A Redditor shared photos of a leaked Xbox Elite Series 3 controller. The prototype controller reportedly features a tiny built-in screen. It was allegedly purchased for $200 on OfferUp.

headline: An FCC filing points to new Sonos headphones coming soon
summary: New Sonos headphones, model S52A, are hinted at by an FCC filing. A successor to the Sonos Ace headphones is expected this fall. CEO Tom Conrad previously mentioned new headphones.

headline: ChatGPT and Gemini both just passed 1 billion users
summary: Google's Gemini AI has reached 1 billion monthly users, its fastest-growing product ever. OpenAI's ChatGPT also achieved the 1 billion user milestone. This highlights the rapid expansion of AI services.

headline: Threads has a VR app now
summary: Meta has launched a Threads app for its Quest VR headsets. This follows its recent availability on Ray-Ban Display AR glasses. Threads recently surpassed 500 million monthly active users.

headline: This LEGO Duplo Deal at Amazon Is the Perfect First Set to Buy a Toddler
summary: Amazon is offering a back-to-school sale on LEGO sets for kids. A specific LEGO Duplo deal is highlighted as ideal for toddlers. The author personally purchased one for their 2-year-old son.

headline: Stop Killing Games Joins Dutch Consumer Group's $457M Lawsuit Against Sony Over Digital Store 'Monopoly'
summary: The Stop Killing Games movement is suing Sony over its digital store practices. The lawsuit, valued at $457 million, alleges Sony holds an illegal monopoly. A Dutch consumer group is also involved in the legal action.

headline: Daran's Affordable 288Wh 600W LiFePO4 Power Station Will Keep Your Electronics Topped Up for Days
summary: A Daran 288Wh 600W LiFePO4 power station is currently on sale. It promises to keep electronics charged for an extended period. Customers can get an extra 37% off with a coupon code.

headline: Purported Xbox Elite Series 3 Controller Prototype Somehow Ends Up in a Customer's Hands
summary: A prototype Xbox Elite Series 3 controller was reportedly sold on OfferUp. The buyer believed they were purchasing an Elite Series 2 controller. The Elite Series 3 has not yet been officially announced by Xbox.

headline: Woman assaulted by double murderer says nightmare became 'real life' when police let him attack again
summary: A woman assaulted by serial sex offender Simon Levy spoke out. Levy went on to murder two women and rape a third. This occurred due to "disastrous decisions" that left him free.

headline: Summer 2026 on course to be UK's hottest on record, says Met Office
summary: The UK's Summer 2026 is projected to be the hottest on record. Only average August conditions are needed to break last year's record. The Met Office issued this forecast.

headline: Police chiefs call for PM to prevent early release of PC Harper's killers
summary: UK police chiefs are urging the Prime Minister to intervene. They seek to prevent the early release of PC Harper's killers. This follows Andy Burnham's confidence that release could be stopped.

headline: Eclipse chasers scramble for glasses as stocks run low
summary: Demand for specialist eclipse glasses has surged. Stocks are nearly sold out online ahead of a significant UK eclipse. This will be the UK's most notable eclipse since 1999.
